state.summary: No evidence exists for the reported symptom (Kafka consumer lag): "kafka", "consumer" and "lag" appear nowhere in the catalog, alerts, logs, metrics or changes. A separate incident, INC-2213, is active: orders-db connection exhaustion after inventory-service DB_POOL_MAX was raised from 20 to 80 (CFG-502) at 13:52. That change coincides with the metric onset at 13:55 (MET-orders_db.active_connections, MET-inventory.db_pool_in_use). It causes checkout errors. It is not a Kafka issue, and I can't link it to the report.
state.impact: Reported Kafka lag: no evidence of impact in this data. The separate INC-2213 started at 13:55 on the metrics. It shows checkout 5xx rising from 0.32% to a 7.9% peak (MET-checkout.error_rate_pct) and orders-db connections at 99% (MET-orders_db.active_connections). Support saw 87 tickets by 14:30 (CUST-001) and 14 reports of cards charged with no order confirmation (CUST-002).
